M0prime.role: Same ladder and Student-t family; D0 source-credit comparison

M0t.derivation: champion_cdf(spec) = apply_emos(build_cdf(NORMAL), percentiles, params) has Normal location m_star and scale s; swap only its kernel to Student-t
M0t.refuse: champion.method != "NORMAL"; non-positive sd or scale; non-finite parameters
M0t.scale_rule: Use exactly the EMOS Normal scale s as the Student-t scale; no variance matching

f9_clause_quote.text: If `oof_rows.jsonl` carries an M0 `arm_predictions` entry (unverified #1), M0 is scored from it with its own nu. Otherwise the M0 baseline is scored from the champion spec under BOTH the Normal CDF and the same Student-t family as the arms; ΔRES is reported against both and the PASS rule uses the t-family baseline. The choice is settled at S1 (first RED test pins the schema) and frozen in PREREG_GAP1 before D1 text is frozen.

baselines.plan_search: Searched plan_r1.md and plan_r2_delta.md for variance, scale, M0t, Student; neither specifies variance matching or a scale conversion. Same-scale is this conservative S0 choice.
baselines.schema_resolution: ARM_NAMES is exactly [M0prime, M1, M2, M3]; no M0 prediction entry. Rebuild M0t and M0n from champion; do not add an M0 arm key.

cells.sensitivity: D0_sensitivity at 12:00 LST is reported only; never a seventh gating cell

census_rule.artifact: Commit counts.json after J2 and before J3
census_rule.go_no_go: If every cell's upper-bound count < prior_floor, architect + prediction-market-reviewer go/no-go before J3
census_rule.no_outcomes: Outcome-blind; never access observed_f, cli_tmax_f, numeric source forecasts, champion, arm scores or stage_a.json
census_rule.upper_bound: Per cell, distinct pre-cutoff (station, climate_day) keys at that horizon, before fold/champion exclusions; include missing-source/fallback candidates under intention-to-treat; report missing-prefix counts separately

ci.B_choice_rule: 10000 unless the S0 benchmark projects more than 4 hours for 10000 x 6 cells x 2 clusterings; then 5000; never below 2000
ci.resampling: Paired whole-cluster resampling; retain all three rungs and both probabilities together in every draw
ci.seed_note: F13 pins.bootstrap_seed (20261006) is NOT used; scoring_core is never imported

disclosures: Brier-sigma_d power floor is applied to a dRES test
Report bootstrap-implied dRES SD for each clustering, non-gating
Six nested correlated cells; Bonferroni m=6 is conservative
Predicted n per cell cannot be frozen before J2; freeze the census RULE and prior floor now and commit counts.json before J3
No scoring_core import; no source, frozen F13 prereg, look-tool or nbp_calibration changes
frozen via UNFROZEN draft commit then a stamp-only commit setting frozen_sha to the draft commit's sha
S1/S2 reader and D1 prerequisites remain future work before any J3 look

estimand.pooling: Pool all three rung events of all included rows within each arm x horizon cell; paired and identical events for every baseline
estimand.uncertainty_rule: Compute and report UNC for every arm and baseline; refuse unless UNC is equal across arms in each cell

events.outcome: lo <= observed_f <= hi inclusive; an open bound means infinity
events.p: rung_probabilities(cdf, ladder): F(hi + 0.5) - F(lo - 0.5); open lower CDF = 0, open upper CDF = 1
events.refuse: Non-integral or non-finite observed_f is refused

inclusion.arm_keys: set(arm_predictions) == set(ARM_NAMES), exactly; refuse missing or extra keys
inclusion.champion: Must be set; champion None excluded and counted
inclusion.fallback: fell_back and LAMP-MISSING rows INCLUDED, intention-to-treat; count per arm
inclusion.fold_id: Must be set (zero is valid); fold_id None excluded and counted
inclusion.lamp_missing_count: Read the LAMP-missing flag from matched J2 features; key by (station, climate_day, horizon); report it and fell_back separately per arm, with their overlap
inclusion.nu_rule: Assert nu == 5 (F13 pins.student_t_nu) on every arm row, including M0prime and fallbacks
inclusion.sensitivity: Report a version excluding fell_back/LAMP-MISSING rows as a non-gating sensitivity; no extra PASS cells

k_cum.added: 6 cells + 1 F13 primary; +1 per burned primary

ladder.common: One champion-centred ladder per OOF row, identical for every arm and all baselines

overall.KILL: All six cells are FAIL or OBS_DRIVEN; D1 must be granted and the frozen prereg and reader prerequisites satisfied
overall.UNRESOLVED: Otherwise; includes no PASS with UNDERPOWERED or RES_ONLY_MISCALIBRATED, or D1 not granted
overall.f13_verdict: Report result.json's F13 verdict as-is, or NOT WRITTEN if result.json is absent; it never overrides GAP-1
overall.look_rule: Single J3 run plus reader in one look window; S0 synthetic benchmark is not a data look

pass_labels.disclosure: The ask-minus-NBP gap was measured on venue rungs, a different event set; indicative comparison only

compute_n_min.role: Reported only, non-gating; N_MIN_CEILING is not applied

power.degenerate_sigma_rule: For sigma_d=0, n_min_adj=0 by the formula; report compute_n_min as undefined (it refuses non-positive sigma). Empty cells are UNDERPOWERED with no verdict statistic.
power.disclosure: The prior sigma is reconstructed from the 2026-09-30 G2.2 NBS-MOS M2-M1 Brier statistic's n_min=592; this is a different statistic from dRES. The source's measured sigma_d=0.13195862875714462 is not the reconstructed prior.
power.n: Number of distinct (station, climate_day) clusters in the cell, not rung-event count
power.sigma_d: pstdev of per-(station, climate_day) mean over the three rungs of ((p_arm-o)^2 - (p_M0t-o)^2)

precedence: OBS_DRIVEN (D0 only: RES_arm - RES_M0prime <= 0; counts as FAIL)

successor.accounting: Retain and cite the burned primary; add one K_cum look per burned primary; at most this one successor is allowed
allowed_only_if: Primary has neither oof_rows.jsonl nor result.json
Journal proves an infrastructure kill: OOM, RuntimeMaxSec, or MemoryError from the address-space cap
Prereg digest, both feature-file sha256 digests checked against build.json, code SHA, and C1 digest are identical
successor.enforcement: Reader and S6 enforce these rules; the primary path is the only ordinary accepted --j3-dir, with the sole conditional exception above
successor.primary_stage_a: NOT outcome-blind: m0_fold_crps uses truth; arm-blind. The successor never reads the primary's stage_a.json, which remains unread until the successor completes
refusal: More than one directory has either oof_rows.jsonl or result.json
A successor exists while primary oof_rows.jsonl exists
Any J3 directory other than the registered primary and this sole conditional successor
Unchanged-input evidence or infrastructure journal evidence is missing

test_plan.T8b: scipy.stats.t(df=5, loc=m_star, scale=s).cdf agrees with student_t_cdf(m_star, s, 5) at the ladder edges (lo-0.5, hi+0.5) within 1e-12
